planets.name: TOI-3884 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-3884 with a 4.54-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-3884 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-3884. Its orbit and size follow Libby-Roberts et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
